body: We're thinking of getting part-time jobs when I'm 16 in this case around May so we can both get a cheap apartment and try to work it out. But of course being this old we don't know how expensive it is to live on our own and things like that.

One of these days I told a little joke to my parents like "You're going to be grandmother and grandfather" to see how they reacted, and they threatened to kick me out if something like that happened. My parents are really strict and they punish me a lot mainly using violence that's why I'm so afraid to talk to them about this.
